issuing_body: U.S. District Court, District of Minnesota
title: United States v. Farah et al. (Mukhtar Mohamed Shariff) - Judgment in a Criminal Case, ECF 789
supports: Judgment as to Mukhtar Mohamed Shariff (defendant 7) orders mandatory restitution of $47,920,514.00, due immediately.

The joint-and-several schedule on the judgment lists Abdiaziz Shafii Farah, Mohamed Jama Ismail, Abdimajid Mohamed Nur and Hayat Mohamed Nur at the same $47,920,514.00: one shared obligation, not additive.
The judgment forfeits the defendant's interest in property listed in the preliminary and final orders of forfeiture.
does_not_support: It does not show any payment or collection.
It is Shariff's judgment only; the co-defendants' own judgments are not captured by this record.
